'''Weeffil Liff's Trading Center''' was located on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], and owned by [[Weeffil Liff]]. It supplied many [[Starship/Legends|starships]] passing through Ord Mantell with [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] and recycling systems. Situated inside a large starship construction area, the Trading Center was split into a warehouse, and a small business area where transactions took place. Heavy [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] secured the hangar.
